title: Compatibility of Fairness Metrics with EU Non-Discrimination Laws: Demographic Parity & Conditional Demographic Disparity
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks or measurements related to faith/religion. It mentions 'religion' as a protected characteristic under EU non-discrimination laws (specifically Article 14 of the ECHR and Article 21 of the CFREU), which provides the legal context for the study of algorithmic fairness. However, the empirical experiments in the paper focus exclusively on the protected attributes of race and gender.
models_tested: Classification models trained with an in-processing bias mitigation meta-algorithm
findings: There are no empirical findings related to religion, as it was not a variable in the experiments. The paper establishes that religion is a legally protected characteristic under the EU non-discrimination framework, making it a relevant category for future algorithmic fairness analysis, but does not provide any specific results on this topic.
